seoDescription: Most FCPS K–12 students start Aug. 12, 2026, with a scheduled last day May 26, 2027. See breaks, return dates, make-up days, PDFs and ICS.
heroSummary: For most FCPS K–12 students, classes begin Wednesday, August 12, 2026. Fall Break is September 28–October 2, Thanksgiving Break is November 25–27, Winter Break is December 21–January 1, and Spring Break is April 5–9. Additional no-class days follow Fall, Winter and Spring Break, so students return October 6, January 5 and April 13. The scheduled last day is Wednesday, May 26, 2027, pending weather make-up days.

customSections.label: FCPS Preschool Has Its Own 2026–27 Calendar
customSections.content: The Fayette County Preschool Program does not follow the district's Aug. 12 K–12 start date. Preschool starts in stages later in August and has additional no-class days throughout the year.

customSections.label: William Wells Brown Elementary Starts Earlier
customSections.content: William Wells Brown Elementary follows the Promise Academy calendar rather than the standard district opening schedule. Classes at William Wells Brown begin Wednesday, July 29, 2026. The school calendar also lists Wednesday, August 5 as a no-class day. Families at WWB should use the school's calendar for the complete schedule.

calendarFaqs.q: Which FCPS dates are possible weather make-up days in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: March 19, May 27–28 and June 1 are listed as possible weather make-up days. They are not confirmed school days unless FCPS designates them as make-up days. The scheduled May 26 last day is marked pending make-up days.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the Fayette County Preschool Program use the same calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The Preschool Program publishes a separate calendar with PM sessions beginning August 24–25, AM and full-day sessions beginning August 26–27, and additional Preschool-only no-class dates.

calendarFaqs.q: Does William Wells Brown Elementary use the same FCPS calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: No. William Wells Brown Elementary follows the Promise Academy calendar. Its school calendar lists July 29, 2026, as the first day of classes and August 5 as a no-class day.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the FCPS ICS calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The ICS file is a one-time import of confirmed districtwide K–12 dates. Check the FCPS calendar for later changes, and use the separate Preschool or William Wells Brown calendar when either applies.
